summary: Iteration 5 e2e test of SQZ catalog covering the navbar fix (no auto-hide on scroll) and the replaced high-res slogan_blue.png. Backend /api/health passes (200 + correct payload). Frontend: navbar always visible at scrolls 0/400/800/1500/3000 and back to 0; correctly toggles between bg-transparent (top) and bg-sqz-bg/90 + backdrop-blur-xl + border-b at scrollY>24. All home sections render (hero, lemon-section, sobre-section, featured-section, slogan-banner-section). Produtos page loads exactly 36 products and 7 filter buttons (all clickable). Zero emojis in rendered HTML. Slogan banner uses /assets/brand/slogan_blue.png and is high-res (1174x1618, file 230KB) — but naturalWidth (1174) does NOT exceed 1500 as the request asserted; image is portrait so naturalHeight is 1618. Minor spec discrepancy only — file size matches the new asset.
action_items: Optional: If the slogan banner is meant to be landscape with width>1500px, replace /app/frontend/public/assets/brand/slogan_blue.png with a wider asset. Current asset is portrait 1174x1618 (230KB). Functionally correct (high-res, matches src + file size), so this is informational only.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar uses Tailwind dynamic class strings like 'bg-sqz-bg/90' which depends on a custom theme color in tailwind.config; verified visually that styles apply (bg + backdrop-blur observed). No issues.
server.py only exposes /api/health; if the catalog grows server-side in the future, add input validation + structured error handling. Out of scope for this iteration.
Console shows benign Framer Motion warning ('container has a non-static position') and React Router v7 future flag warnings — non-blocking but easy to clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has only /api/health. Frontend has data-testid attributes for navbar, hero, hero-title, lemon-section, slogan-banner-section, sobre-section, featured-section, product-card-*, filter-button-*. Use viewport 1920x1080. Lenis smooth scroll is active but window.scrollTo + window.scrollY work fine for tests. Iteration 5 verified the navbar no longer auto-hides on scroll and the slogan_blue.png is the new 230KB high-res asset (1174x1618, portrait).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. The single 'failure' in the playwright run (naturalWidth not > 1500) is a spec mismatch: the new slogan asset is portrait (1174x1618), not landscape; file size 230KB matches the new asset declared in the request, confirming the replacement happened.
